notes.title: First Release&Original Price Player Compensation Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello players, yesterday we announced that we will offer a significant discount of 40% on August 25th, with an expected purchase price of 40.8 yuan. However, we have previously emphasized that we will not backstab crowdfunding players. Therefore, we promise in our announcement to release free expansion packs in the future to thank everyone for their support and tolerance of 'Moon White Star Dou'.

However, due to the significant discount we offered shortly after the release, in order to compensate players who made their debut or full price purchases (limited to transaction amounts of 68 yuan and 61.2 yuan), we have decided to provide corresponding compensation measures after discussion.

Before August 24th, players who purchase at the original price or purchase at the initial discount and have played for more than two hours can receive our peripheral blind boxes. The peripheral blind box includes three bars, two keychains, and one signboard, whichever is random.

And in order to give back to the players who have been with us all this time, we have decided to create a brand new free DLC in the future and give it as a gift to all players as a thank you for your continuous support.
